Luke — attaching SOW v3 with the pilot terms we discussed. Two items I want to flag so we don't get stuck in legal: 1) Hearthwell asked for an opt-out in the first 90 days with a prorated refund, and 2) they want a clause that allows them to pause the paid pilot after month one without penalty.

Proposed counter (short):
- Staged off-ramp: 50% credit if terminated within first 30 days, 25% credit for days 31–60, no credit thereafter (applies to committed pilot fees only).
- Pause request: allow a single 14-day pause during the first 60 days with no credit; additional pauses count as termination.

I think this is reasonable compromise given the onboarding support and custom connector work Marcus has scoped. If Hearthwell insists on a 90-day full opt-out we need approval for a larger onboarding credit and possible SLA carveout.

Attachments: Hearthwell_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), staged-credit-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)
